# Tokens

Every token of the system, a section per group: Surfaces — 1 token; Text — 4 tokens; Fills and status backgrounds — 1 token; Borders and rings — 1 token; Palette ramps and brand — 22 tokens; Type styles, families, font files; Spacing — 6 tokens; Radius — 4 tokens; Shadow — 1 token; Layout — 5 tokens.

## Color · Surfaces

### Use

```css
/* in a page’s CSS: the token’s name, with its value from the same row of the table below as the fallback, so the page draws whether or not it links tokens.css */
color: var(--paper, #ffffff);
/* on a slide, in a chart’s options, or anywhere else var() cannot go, and in an SVG attribute such as fill, which not every browser reads var() in: the value alone */
color: #ffffff;
```

### Tokens (1)

| token | light | usage |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--paper` | #ffffff | Page background behind all reading content. The content area is always plain white: colour lives only in the frame (masthead and footer bands). |

## Color · Text

### Use

```css
/* in a page’s CSS: the token’s name, with its value from the same row of the table below as the fallback, so the page draws whether or not it links tokens.css */
color: var(--ink, #333333);
/* on a slide, in a chart’s options, or anywhere else var() cannot go, and in an SVG attribute such as fill, which not every browser reads var() in: the value alone */
color: #333333;
```

### Tokens (4)

| token | light | usage |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--ink` | #333333 | Body text on paper (12.6:1). Default text colour for paragraphs, lists, footer text. |
| `--ink-strong` | #222222 | Headings h1–h3 and post titles in the listing, on paper (15.9:1). |
| `--ink-max` | #000000 | Listing page title ("Posts") and ::selection text. Use sparingly: one element per page. |
| `--ink-muted` | #666666 | Dates, post meta, h4, blockquote text and blockquote rule, on paper (5.7:1). |

## Color · Palette ramps and brand

### Use

```css
/* in a page’s CSS: the token’s name, with its value from the same row of the table below as the fallback, so the page draws whether or not it links tokens.css */
color: var(--rule, #dddddd);
/* on a slide, in a chart’s options, or anywhere else var() cannot go, and in an SVG attribute such as fill, which not every browser reads var() in: the value alone */
color: #dddddd;
```

### Tokens (22)

| token | light | usage |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--rule` | #dddddd | 1px bottom border of the footer band. |
| `--night` | #142c66 | Fallback colour of the masthead and footer bands, shown under/before the frame photo. Ground for all on-night text. |
| `--night-deep` | #000050 | Dominant tone sampled from the masthead photo (ultramarine, #000040–#000090 range). Use as the solid band colour if you skip the photo. |
| `--ember` | #e72833 | The ONE hot accent: the site name in the masthead, nothing else. On night 3.0:1 — passes only as large text (28px); keep it ≥24px and prefer weight 400 over 300. |
| `--ember-glow` | #af3745 | Average of the red filaments sampled from the footer photo (~8% of its pixels). Decorative only — never text. |
| `--nav-on-night` | #eeeeee | Navigation links on the masthead, on night (11.4:1). |
| `--link` | #4183c4 | REFERENCE link colour in body text and footer. FLAG: 3.99:1 on paper — fails WCAG AA for 18px body text. Replace with link-accessible. |
| `--link-hover` | #4a8fe7 | REFERENCE hover/active link colour, and nav link colour under 640px. FLAG: 3.29:1 on paper, 4.03:1 on night — fails AA. Replace with link-accessible-hover. |
| `--link-accessible` | #2f6ea8 | PROPOSED link colour on paper (5.4:1). Same hue as the reference blue, darker. |
| `--link-accessible-hover` | #245f94 | PROPOSED hover/active link colour on paper (6.7:1). Pair with an underline on hover so the change does not rely on colour alone. |
| `--code-border` | #d0d7de | 1.25px border around highlighted code blocks (GitHub-light palette). |
| `--code-surface` | #f6f8fa | Subtle code background (GitHub-light canvas-subtle). The reference draws code on white; use this for inline code if you add a tint. |
| `--syntax-keyword` | #cf222e | Code keywords, on paper (5.4:1). |
| `--syntax-string` | #0a3069 | Code strings and multiline comments, on paper (12.8:1). |
| `--syntax-comment` | #6e7781 | Code comments, on paper (4.55:1 — just passes). |
| `--syntax-entity` | #8250df | Code entities / function names, on paper. |
| `--syntax-constant` | #0550ae | Code operators and constants, on paper. |
| `--grid-low` | #6d9aae | Carbon-aware widget: low-intensity state (text, dot, toggle-on track). On night 4.35:1 — fine at 12–13px only because it is paired with a dot and a label. |
| `--grid-medium` | #f17e93 | Carbon-aware widget: moderate-intensity state, on night (5.2:1). |
| `--grid-high` | #dc183c | Carbon-aware widget: high-intensity TEXT. FLAG: 2.7:1 on night — too dark for small text; use grid-high-dot for text too. |
| `--grid-high-dot` | #f44336 | Carbon-aware widget: high-intensity dot, on night (3.6:1 — OK for a non-text indicator). |
| `--grid-unknown` | #cccccc | Carbon-aware widget: dot and toggle track before the zone is detected / when off. |

## Type

Set text in one of the styles below: write its values from the Styles and Families tables, or, on a page that links or inlines tokens.css, prefer its variable, where the Styles table’s CSS column gives one.

### Use

```css
/* any surface: a style’s values from the Styles and Families tables */
font: 300 28px/1.7 "IBM Plex Sans", "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif; letter-spacing: 1px;
/* a page that links or inlines tokens.css: prefer the variables, so that a change to tokens.css reaches the page */
font: var(--text-site-name); letter-spacing: 1px;
font-family: var(--font-sans);   /* the family alone */
```

### Styles

| style | CSS | size / line, italic, letter spacing | weight | family | usage |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `site-name` | `.site-name`, `--text-site-name` | 28px / 1.7, letter-spacing 1px | 300 | `sans` | The site name, in ember, on the masthead band. |
| `tagline` | `.tagline`, `--text-tagline` | 16px / 1.4 | 400 | `sans` | One-line role under the name, in on-night; pulled up 5px (margin-top: -5px). |
| `nav-link` | `.nav-link`, `--text-nav-link` | 18px / 1.4, letter-spacing 1px | 300 | `sans` | Masthead navigation, nav-on-night, 20px apart. 16px under 640px. |
| `page-title` | `.page-title`, `--text-page-title` | 30px / 1.7 | 700 | `sans` | h1 of a page or article, ink-strong. Line-height 1.7 is loose for two-line titles; consider 1.25. |
| `heading-2` | `.heading-2`, `--text-heading-2` | 24px / 1.7 | 700 | `sans` | h2 in articles and the post titles in the listing, ink-strong. |
| `heading-3` | `.heading-3`, `--text-heading-3` | 20px / 1.7 | 700 | `sans` | h3, ink-strong. |
| `heading-4` | `.heading-4`, `--text-heading-4` | 18px / 1.7 | 700 | `sans` | h4, in ink-muted (the only grey heading). |
| `body` | `.body`, `--text-body` | 18px / 1.4 | 400 | `serif` | Paragraphs, lists, footer, in ink. 15px vertical rhythm between paragraphs. PROPOSED: 1.6 line-height for a serif at this size. |
| `date-italic` | `.date-italic`, `--text-date-italic` | 18px / 1.4, italic | 400 | `serif` | Date under an article title, ink-muted, italic. |
| `post-meta` | `.post-meta`, `--text-post-meta` | 14px / 1.4 | 400 | `serif` | Date above each post title in the listing, ink-muted. |
| `blockquote` | `.blockquote`, `--text-blockquote` | 22px / 1.4, italic | 400 | `serif` | Pull quotes: ink-muted italic, 2px ink-muted rule on the left, 1.8em/0.8em margin. |
| `read-more` | `.read-more`, `--text-read-more` | 15px / 1.4 | 400 | `serif` | Uppercase "read more" link under excerpts. |
| `code` | `.code`, `--text-code` | 12px / 1.4 | 400 | `mono` | Code blocks and inline code. 12px against 18px body is small; PROPOSED 15px. |
| `status-value` | `.status-value`, `--text-status-value` | 13px / 1 | 400 | `sans` | Carbon-aware widget: detected zone, on night. |
| `status-label` | `.status-label`, `--text-status-label` | 12px / 1 | 400 | `sans` | Carbon-aware widget: intensity text and toggle label, on night. |

### Families

| family | CSS variable | stack |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `serif` | `--font-serif` | `"IBM Plex Serif", Georgia, serif` |
| `sans` | `--font-sans` | `"IBM Plex Sans", "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif` |
| `mono` | `--font-mono` | `"IBM Plex Mono", ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, "SF Mono", Menlo, Consolas, "Liberation Mono", monospace` |

## Spacing

### Use

```css
/* any surface: a token’s value from the table below */
padding: 5px;
/* a page that links or inlines tokens.css: prefer the token’s name, so that a change to tokens.css reaches the page */
padding: var(--space-xs);
```

### Tokens (6)

| token | value | usage |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--space-xs` | 5px | Tagline pulled up under the name (-5px). |
| `--space-s` | 10px | Container side gutter; gap above each post in the listing; mobile nav link spacing. |
| `--space-m` | 15px | The base rhythm: paragraph margins, heading bottom margins, gap after a post title, avatar gap. |
| `--space-l` | 20px | Masthead and footer vertical padding; gap between nav links. |
| `--space-xl` | 30px | List indent; article h1 top margin. |
| `--space-2xl` | 50px | Gap between the main column and the footer band. |

## Layout

### Use

```css
/* any surface: a token’s value from the table below (--container-max: 740px) */
/* a page that links or inlines tokens.css: prefer var(--container-max), so that a change to tokens.css reaches the page */
```

### Tokens (5)

| token | value | usage |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--container-max` | 740px | Max width of the single column, including 10px gutters on each side. |
| `--measure` | 720px | Resulting text measure: ~80 characters of 18px IBM Plex Serif. |
| `--breakpoint-narrow` | 640px | Single breakpoint: masthead centres, nav drops below the name, heading line-height tightens to 1.4. |
| `--main-min-height` | 70vh | Keeps the footer band low on short pages. |
| `--masthead-image-height` | 129px | Height of the reference masthead photo (1134×129, ≈8.8:1, background-size: cover). The band itself is content height: 20px padding + name + tagline. |
